title: Digital Transaction Simulation 1

steps.title: Open Service
steps.instruction: Open the service and choose the correct option.
steps.tip: Always verify the official app before making payments.

uiElement.label: Google Pay Home
uiElement.subtext: Choose how you want to proceed

steps.title: Select Recipient
steps.instruction: Choose the correct recipient or service.
steps.tip: Double check the name before sending money.

steps.title: Enter Amount
steps.instruction: Enter the amount to proceed.
steps.tip: Verify the amount before confirming.

steps.title: Confirm Details
steps.instruction: Verify the payment information carefully.

steps.title: Enter PIN
steps.instruction: Enter your secure PIN to authorize the transaction.
steps.tip: Never share your PIN with anyone.

steps.title: Transaction Successful
steps.instruction: Your transaction has been completed successfully.

fraudWarning: Never share OTP or PIN with anyone. Banks will never ask for it.
completionMessage: Great! You completed the simulation successfully.
